purpose: Dated, sourced minimum wage rows for all 56 places, for the coordinator to integrate into the canonical starting-law wage terms. Not read by game code.

conventions.value: Hourly minimum in minor units (cents), matching lawTerms value/unit 'minor/hour' in data/research/laws/starting-law-2026.json.
conventions.operativeAt: Date the rate takes effect. Never backdated.

operativeBasis.source-stated-effective-date: The quoted source states this effective date.
operativeBasis.source-stated-year: The source states the year; the date is January 1 as the same page states for the next year.
operativeBasis.statute-stated-schedule: Federal or state law states the schedule; the amount follows from the quoted rule.
operativeBasis.statute-date-corrected-to-federal: State law tracks the federal rate; the state page's date was wrong and the federal effective date is used.
operativeBasis.in-force-as-of-source-date: The source states no effective date; the date is the source's own 'updated' date.
operativeBasis.in-force-as-read: The source states no effective date; the date is the day it was read (2026-10-01).

conventions.status: in-force: operativeAt on or before asOf; scheduled: later.
conventions.level: state, district, territory, or federal (federal law sets the rate).

quoteCheck.text: Cut from the downloaded page text, verbatim.
quoteCheck.fetch-extract: The page refused direct download here (403 or empty); a fetch tool returned the text when asked to copy it word for word.

conventions.tiers: tier names a statutory tier (region, employer size, employer revenue, coverage, or industry). City and county ordinances, tipped, youth, and training rates are not tiers here.
